name: sql-console
title: SqlConsole
description: A SQL workbench for a PGlite database, made of parts: a header with the versions and a Database menu (SQL / data-directory export and import), a sidebar with the schema (a Tree over schemaTreeItems) and the history, the SqlConsoleEditor (a highlighted textarea on UI SDK's Textarea: ⌘/Ctrl+Enter runs, ↑/↓ history, an error squiggle and invalid state, a footer part; also usable on its own) and a DataTable per statement with typed headers, type-aware cells, labelled stacked rows and CSV / JSON copy, or the error with its line, caret, SQLSTATE and hint. Its text is controlled or uncontrolled (value / defaultValue / onValueChange).
